l1_response.perfect_state_identity_scope: if predicted physical gaps are exact, the overlay reproduces the frozen V+K3+K4 endpoint response

statistical_identities.raw_mse: M_U(y)=sum_{a!=b}<T_a-y,T_b-y>/(32*31*1024), exactly unbiased for squared error to the MC-law endpoint mean when y is fixed before MC
statistical_identities.paired_gain: D_b=(||T_b-y_on||^2-||T_b-y_zero||^2)/1024; common block noise cancels the quadratic term
statistical_identities.cross_response_caveat: cross identities remove independent additive noise only if each response replicate is unbiased; EDG2 is nonlinear, so finite-P unbiasedness is not asserted
statistical_identities.two_sample_jackknife: thetaJ=theta+15(theta-mean theta_A,-b)+15(theta-mean theta_B,-b); VJ=(15/16)sum_A deviations^2+(15/16)sum_B deviations^2
statistical_identities.dual_gate: both uncorrected and jackknife-corrected values must pass the same adverse four-SE threshold
statistical_identities.replica_ball_scope: deterministically bounds error/cosine/component dots against either observed replicate; does not prove the unknown population response lies in the ball
statistical_identities.boundary_law: nonpositive cross norm, negative squared error, invalid cosine, nonfinite value, or four-SE domain crossing is terminal MC_RESOLUTION_INSUFFICIENT and is never clamped
statistical_identities.panel_se: sqrt(sum row_variances)/4 for four independent predeclared rows
statistical_identities.four_se_coverage: protocol-defined conservative nominal rule; not a distribution-free confidence guarantee for unbounded network outputs

p8m_sufficiency.finding: two independent P8M streams are enough to estimate the frozen statistics but no source-free theorem guarantees intervals narrow enough at the 1e-8 and 3.79871e-6 gates
p8m_sufficiency.known_scale_warning: historical endpoint MC noise is of the same order as the raw threshold and nonlinear K3/K4 response uncertainty can be larger
